hot_mask_reference: absolute clean FT error, separately for single and multi64
hot_mask_evaluation: freeze before evaluating noisy results; apply each mask to all four pipelines
geometric_mask: outermost radius shells; keep complete equal-radius shells, report actual pixel fraction
hot_mask_budget: exactly the same number of pixels as geometric outer mask
primary_metric: fraction of total squared wavefront error in outermost 10 percent pixels
secondary_metrics: frozen hot-mask RMS and error concentration
overlap of frozen hot mask and geometric edge
minimum outer pixel fraction accounting for 80 percent squared error
unbinned cumulative RMS as evaluation NA grows
clean bias and finite-seed variance decomposition
primary_comparison: within each saved fixed system; no refit or propagation
between_system_comparison: association within compensated scalar Fresnel family; no causal NA attribution
uncertainty: mean and sample SD across 5 noise seeds; paired differences use the same seed; pixels are not independent replicates
preserve: raw pupil waves, all 35 nonpiston modes; no piston/tilt/defocus removal; original observations and all historical outputs
